scope: Actual extracted HUD functions executed together against small DOM/window/clock stubs; no browser paint, native game or emulator execution.

checks.name: Saving event followed by repeated combat HUD refreshes keeps SAVE disabled
Combat HUD reads current saving state even before its feedback event is delivered
Acknowledged completion reenables SAVE and retains success feedback through HUD refresh
A pending STOP locks SAVE during completion until STOP is actually acknowledged
Failure permits RETRY only when STOP is no longer pending
Retired battles keep SAVE disabled across feedback and combat HUD updates
An old success timer cannot clear a newer save lock
Save-only locking preserves other command enablement and existing combat/zoom states
